# Ananya Electrical Solutions — Full Reference Documentation
> Government-licensed Super Grade electrical contractor headquartered in Sahakarnagar, Bengaluru, providing turnkey 11kV–110kV substations, HT/LT panels, BESCOM & CEIG approvals, industrial wiring, and commercial rooftop solar EPC across Karnataka.

## Organization Details
- **Company Name:** Ananya Electrical Solutions
- **License Class:** Government of Karnataka Licensed Super Grade Electrical Contractor & Class-1 PWD Registered

## Key Service Disciplines
1. **HT/LT Substations & Switchgear:**
   - 11kV, 33kV, 66kV, and 110kV indoor and outdoor substations.
   - Power transformers (oil-immersed ONAN and dry-type cast resin).
   - Vacuum Circuit Breakers (VCB), Air Circuit Breakers (ACB), Ring Main Units (RMU).
   - Form-4b Power Control Centers (PCC) and Motor Control Centers (MCC).
   - Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) panels and harmonic detuned filters.

2. **Statutory Approvals & Discom Liaison:**
   - Single Line Diagram (SLD) preparation and drawing sanction from Chief Electrical Inspector to Government (CEIG).
   - BESCOM, MESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, and CHESCOM power sanctions and grid interconnections.
   - NABL-calibrated testing: Megger insulation resistance, contact resistance, relay coordination, earth grid resistance.
   - Safety certificates and work completion reports.

3. **Industrial & Commercial Electrification:**
   - Turnkey electrical engineering for manufacturing plants, cleanrooms, and data centers.
   - Heavy-duty perforated and ladder-type cable trays, armored HT/LT XLPE cabling.
   - Chemical earthing systems complying with IS 3043 and ESE lightning arresters complying with NFC 17-102.
   - Energy audits, thermographic infrared surveys, and 24/7 industrial preventive AMC.

4. **Turnkey Rooftop Solar EPC:**
   - Commercial, industrial, and residential solar power plants.
   - Tier-1 monocrystalline bifacial PV modules and grid-tie string/hybrid inverters.
   - BESCOM bidirectional net metering, CEIG solar inspection, and synchronization.
   - Grounding, DC surge protection (Type-2 SPD), and remote generation monitoring.
